title: Seven planned bugs have sh or git grep repros a headless done now refuses, so a runner can never close them
goal: The repros of BG-2i46kz3z, BG-2sii6tie, BG-4y2lhglg, BG-57n4r577, BG-6a7jiylf, BG-dvs4vzr6 and BG-ykxthe5x are python3 _tools/ forms (a tests.py -k selection of a planted test, or a python3 _tools/ tool run) that fail now for the same defect, so bl_intake.check_program_refusal admits them and a headless done can run them; a test reads every open item's repro and check and asserts none is refused headless (test named open_repros_run_headless); found by the SP-zihqagoi re-review

run: import sys,json,glob;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_intake as b;bad=[p for p in glob.glob('kb/_self/backlog/*.json') if json.load(open(p)).get('status') in ('todo','draft','doing') and json.load(open(p)).get('repro') and b.check_program_refusal(json.load(open(p))['repro']['run'])];print(len(bad));sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
